text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, building on a four-day rally that's brought the stock up $6 from its November 6 low. The recovery tracks with oil prices holding firm — US crude at $89.62 and global crude at $92.14 — and follows positive analyst calls on the company from November 11. The stock has clawed back most of its two-week losses as energy markets stabilized after earlier weakness.

The broader backdrop matters: heating oil prices are up 59% year-over-year, signaling tight energy markets heading into winter, even as Russian production has recently rebounded. While that rebound adds some supply pressure, elevated heating oil costs underscore persistent demand strength in energy markets, which typically supports crude-linked stocks like ConocoPhillips.
